description: Save a job to the user's BirJob saved jobs (the same list as on birjob.com). Use this when the user asks to save, bookmark or keep a job for later. Saving a saved job again changes nothing. Do not use to record an application (track_application). Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to sign in to BirJob and allow access.

job_id.description: The job id from search_jobs, or its birjob.com job URL.

name: save_job

url.description: The job's page on birjob.com when this call saved an open job, else null.

title: Save a job on BirJob
